title: Why Airplane Windows Have Tiny Holes
text:
Ever noticed the tiny hole in an airplane window? It's there on purpose ✈️

Plane windows have three panes. The bleed hole in the middle pane lets cabin air into the gap, so the outer pane carries the pressure and the middle pane stays in reserve.

Send this to someone with a flight coming up.
